description: Custom-styled scroll container that replaces native browser scrollbars. Provides consistent, on-brand scrollbars across browsers. Use anywhere content can overflow its container.
css: .ds-scroll-area { position:relative; overflow:hidden; } .ds-scroll-viewport { width:100%; height:100%; overflow:scroll; scrollbar-width:none; -ms-overflow-style:none; } .ds-scroll-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar { display:none; } .ds-scroll-bar { position:absolute; display:flex; user-select:none; touch-action:none; padding:2px; border-radius:3px; transition:background 160ms ease; } .ds-scroll-bar.ds-scroll-bar--vertical { top:0; right:0; width:10px; height:100%; flex-direction:column; } .ds-scroll-bar.ds-scroll-bar--horizontal { bottom:0; left:0; height:10px; width:100%; flex-direction:row; } .ds-scroll-bar:hover { background:var(--shell-hover); } .ds-scroll-thumb { flex:1; background:var(--shell-elevated); border-radius:3px; position:relative; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms; } .ds-scroll-thumb::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:100%; height:100%; min-width:44px; min-height:44px; } .ds-scroll-thumb:hover,.ds-scroll-bar:hover .ds-scroll-thumb { background:var(--shell-text-muted); }

native_fallback.description: Minimal CSS-only approach for non-critical surfaces where Radix ScrollArea is unavailable.
native_fallback.css: /* Apply to the scrollable element directly */ .ds-native-scroll { overflow-y:auto; scrollbar-width:thin; scrollbar-color:var(--shell-elevated) transparent; } .ds-native-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { width:6px; } .ds-native-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background:transparent; } .ds-native-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:var(--shell-elevated); border-radius:3px; } .ds-native-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background:var(--shell-text-muted); }

use_cases: PAICustomLegends — horizontal scroll for long legend lists
Filter drawer attribute/value panels — vertical scroll
Detail drawer body — vertical scroll within fixed-height panel
do: Always set an explicit height or max-height on ds-scroll-area — it needs a constrained container.
Use ds-native-scroll CSS class for simple use cases where Radix is not available.
aria-hidden='true' on scrollbar elements — they are decorative.
Keep scrollbar track transparent — only the thumb should be visible.
dont: Never set overflow:auto on the shell content area — the DS shell already handles page scroll.
Never use custom scrollbars inside the topbar or nav.
Never hide scrollbars entirely when content overflows — users need to know more content exists.

react.example:
import * as ScrollArea from '@radix-ui/react-scroll-area';
<ScrollArea.Root className="ds-scroll-area" style={{height:'300px'}}>
  <ScrollArea.Viewport className="ds-scroll-viewport">
    {/* content */}
  </ScrollArea.Viewport>
  <ScrollArea.Scrollbar className="ds-scroll-bar ds-scroll-bar--vertical" orientation="vertical">
    <ScrollArea.Thumb className="ds-scroll-thumb" />
  </ScrollArea.Scrollbar>
  <ScrollArea.Corner />
</ScrollArea.Root>
